hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. beforeSwap takes the input token, deposits it into an Euler vault, withdraws the output token from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — replacing CLAMM pricing with a custom curve invariant. Standard concentrated liquidity additions and donations are blocked via intentional reverts.
